import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static int solve(int n, int[] v) {
        int result = 0;
        for (int i : v) {
            result += i;
        }
        result /= n;
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] v = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            v[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        System.out.println(solve(n, v));
        sc.close();
    }
}
